```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
Feng_Screening<-read_csv("Feng_Screening.csv")
```
```{r}
Feng_Screening%>%summary("Feng_Screening")
```
```{r}
Feng_Screening_Table<-Feng_Screening%>%table(Feng_Screening$software,Feng_Screening$booklet)
print(Data_Screening_Table)
```






```{r}
Read_rt_ms_by_participant<-Feng_Screening%>%group_by(subject_id)%>%summarise(mean_read_rt = mean(read_rt_ms), sd_read_rt=sd(read_rt_ms), min_read_rt=min(read_rt_ms), max_read_rt=max(read_rt_ms))
print(Read_rt_ms_by_participant)
```
```{r}
Read_rt_ms_by_project<-Feng_Screening%>%group_by(project)%>%summarise(proj_mean_read_rt=mean(read_rt_ms), proj_sd_read_rt=sd(read_rt_ms))
print(Read_rt_ms_by_project)
```
```{r}
Comprehension_Correct_by_project<-Feng_Screening%>%group_by(project)%>%summarise(proj_mean_comprehension_correct=mean(comprehension_correct), proj_sd_comprehension_correct=sd(comprehension_correct))
print(Comprehension_Correct_by_project)
```
```{r}
Comprehension_Correct_by_subject<-Feng_Screening%>%group_by(subject_id)%>%summarise(subj_mean_comprehension_correct=mean(comprehension_correct), subj_sd_comprehension_correct=sd(comprehension_correct))
print(Comprehension_Correct_by_subject)
```
